title: Supplementary RCS A05 author recording reference
provenance_scope: Author page links published bank and hardware demonstration. Actual decoded video frames identify patch labels; no exact recorded parameter revision or original musical performance MIDI is authenticated.
unknowns: Original notes, velocity, gate lengths, pedal/controller events and oscillator phase history remain unknown.
Author SMF downloads contain SysEx patch data and zero note events.
Published patches and on-screen names do not prove the absence of live edits or external recording processing.
YouTube audio is lossy Opus; it is not an unprocessed hardware capture.
